members.description: Identities that will be bound to the role. Supported formats include: allUsers, allAuthenticatedUsers, user:{emailid}, serviceAccount:{emailid}, group:{emailid}, domain:{domain}, projectOwner:{projectid}, projectEditor:{projectid}, projectViewer:{projectid}.
members.security_impact: Overly permissive members (e.g., allUsers) can expose the SCC source to the public, leading to serious security risks.
members.rationale: IAM bindings should be restricted to specific, trusted principals to avoid privilege escalation or data exposure.
members.compliant: Members list contains only approved principals (e.g., specific users, groups, or service accounts).
members.non-compliant: Members list includes public identities (e.g., allUsers, allAuthenticatedUsers) or unapproved principals.

role.description: The role assigned to members. Example: roles/viewer, roles/editor, roles/admin. Custom roles must follow the format [projects|organizations]/{parent-name}/roles/{role-name}.
role.security_impact: Assigning overly privileged roles (e.g., owner, admin) can lead to unauthorized changes or data exposure.
role.rationale: Restrict roles to the minimum required for SCC operations, following the principle of least privilege.
role.compliant: Role is set to approved values such as Viewer, Editor, or Admin as per organizational policy.
role.non-compliant: Role is set to Owner or other disallowed roles, granting excessive privileges.
